text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The United Nations special envoy to Angola, Alioune Blondin Beye, met Zambia's foreign relations minister, Lowrence Shimba, on the status of Angola's peace process.
- Police have no information about the cause of an explosion at an ammunitions dump outside Luanda at the weekend. Military sources say the depot was scheduled to have been destroyed.
- Angolan President Jose Eduardo dos Santos has invited Morocco's King Hassan to the inauguration of an Angolan unity government.
- Another 134 UNITA soldiers were integrated into the Angolan Armed Forces at the end of last week.
